hookups.source: https://www.roverpass.com/c/little-wolf-town-campground-tupper-lake-ny/ (the town's booking page: 'Full Hookups (30/50 Amps)', 'Partial Hookups (30 Amps)'; 'most of which have electric and water hookups and sewage disposal'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 45 camper sites, most full hookup, a few electric and water only, plus 8 tent sites at the other end of the beach; the tourism listing says 50 sites.

values.note: The town's 'BOOK NOW' link goes to its RoverPass page; some sites are Instant Book, the rest need the campground's approval.

facilities.source: https://www.roverpass.com/c/little-wolf-town-campground-tupper-lake-ny/ ('indoor & outdoor showers are provided for registered guests') + https://www.tupperlake.com/campgrounds/little-wolf-beach-campground (the listing the town page sends readers to: 'Dump Station, ... note: Town of Tupper Lake campground on Little Wolf Pond. Lifeguarded beach; waterfront rows (many seasonal). --Claude
summary: Town page + its RoverPass booking page confirm Memorial Day - Sep 30 (closes confirmed), 30/50 A full hookups (electric 50 added), 45 RV + 8 tent sites, RoverPass booking (instant book for some sites), showers, flush toilets, dump, wifi. Fees ($25 RV sites) left as read 2026-10-11 from the same booking page. Note trimmed of site/season/booking restatements.
